mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.title, c.name as category_name, m.nickname as member_nickname, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.duration, v.ended_at FROM vote v JOIN category c ON c.id = v.category_id JOIN member m ON m.id = v.member_id ORDER BY v.created_at DESC

SELECT v.id, v.title, c.name as category_name, m.nickname as member_nickname, v.content, ch.nickname as challenger_nickname, v.challenger_content, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.duration, v.ended_at FROM vote v JOIN category c ON v.category_id = c.id JOIN member m ON m.id = v.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN member ch ON ch.id = v.challenger_id WHERE v.id = #{id} AND v.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN vt.content = 'home' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS homeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN vt.content = 'away' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS awayCount, SUM(CASE WHEN vt.content = 'neutral' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neutralCount FROM vote v JOIN voter vt ON v.id = vt.vote_id WHERE v.id = #{id}

SELECT v.id, v.title, c.name as category_name, m.nickname as member_nickname, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.duration, v.ended_at FROM vote v JOIN category c ON c.id = v.category_id JOIN member m ON m.id = v.member_id WHERE v.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY v.created_at DESC

SELECT v.id, v.title, c.name as category_name, m.nickname as member_nickname, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.duration, v.ended_at FROM vote v JOIN category c ON c.id = v.category_id JOIN member m ON m.id = v.member_id WHERE v.challenger_id = #{challengerId} ORDER BY v.created_at DESC

SELECT v.id, v.title, c.name AS category_name, m.nickname AS member_nickname, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.duration, v.ended_at FROM vote v JOIN category c ON c.id = v.category_id JOIN member m ON m.id = v.member_id
v.deleted_at IS NULL
AND v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND v.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickname}, '%')
AND v.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%')
ORDER BY v.created_at DESC
